content:
**Vodka** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A white bottle containing Surkov brand vodka, imported from Russia before the Great War. Consuming the vodka provides an increase to maximum Hit Points, an increase to Strength, and a decrease to Intelligence for 3 minutes.

Similar to other fermentable pre-War beverages, vodka is initially crafted as fermentable vodka, offering no benefits, inflicting 30 rads, and having a significantly high disease chance of 9% until fully fermented.

Vodka can be crafted using the brewing and distilling functionality of Wild Appalachia.
